newsitem.title: YEMEN: Tribesmen kidnap Italian tourist in Yemen.
newsitem.headline: Tribesmen kidnap Italian tourist in Yemen.

text.p: Yemeni tribesmen have kidnapped an Italian tourist and taken him to a province southeast of the capital Sanaa, diplomats and security officials said on Thursday.
"I confirm that an Italian tourist has been kidnapped," an Italian diplomat said, but gave no details. "We are waiting for news," he said.
Yemeni sources said the tourist was kidnapped on Wednesday.
A security official said the Italian man was kidnapped by members of a Yemeni tribe who took him to an area called Radaa in al-Baidha province, 150 kms (93 miles) southeast of Sanaa.
The official did not give any other details.

Kidnapping of foreigners in the poor state at the southern end of the Arabian peninsula is a common ploy by tribesmen holding grievances against the government or foreign oil firms operating in the country.
Late last month Yemeni tribesmen kidnapped two Italian tourists near the capital Sanaa and released them a day later.
